bio_en: Harutiun Harutiunian, known as Khokha, was a brave member of the ARF fighting groups who carried out dangerous assignments without question. His memories revered Dro above all. He spent his later life in Iran. He died a few days after reaching Mashhad, as reported in Alik on 25 October 1965.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: low.
